name: overhead-barbell-carry
instructions:
1. Set a bar at roughly chest height.
2. Set up facing away from the rack and unrack the bar at shoulder height in a overhead press position.
3. Press the bar to lockout and maintain a stable overhead position..
4. Walk for a designated distance or amount of time.
